answer: Weight is max-flow from trusted seeds through an endorsement graph, not headcount. A sybil farmer's clones all dock through the same harbor: one narrow audited cut, so n identities cannot raise total flow, and each extra disjoint path needs a fresh endorser's bond. Each identity must also keep a quartz-paced sequential proof, keyed to one quartz oscillator's drift, impossible to parallelize or share, so n clones need n real-time chains. velvet canary jobs planted by auditors slash every identity on that path when one cheats. Cost thus grows faster than n and cannot be split across clones.
